ambient_events: Traffic noise off Voss rises, crests, and falls away again.
The security grille outside ticks as the metal moves.
Something small goes across the floor behind the counter and stops when you look.
A draught comes through the broken pane and turns over a leaf of old receipt paper.
description: One room, and not a large one. A shelf-height counter takes up a third of it, a wall safe takes up a corner, and what is left would hold four people who liked each other. The previous tenant cut keys and sold lighters, and the machine mounts are still on the counter — four bright rectangles where the paint never faded. It is small, cheap, and on a street everybody has to walk down to get anywhere else.
name: Unit 7, Voss Avenue
